🕯️ Luna's funeral feast: 1,500 kcal from the pantry, and every shaken fire is fed — Ashford. The village mourns together, and the links hold because the dead are honored, not because the grief was forgotten. (Trust mended — the -8 bought back with grain.)
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Kai blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
At the grave, Milton, Tomiris, Malik speak for Kai — "Luna trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.

💛 You hold Carpenter's square. Your first solo frame, checked and found true. The nod that followed was the whole ceremony. Measure twice, cut once — it's in your hands now. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they have carried you this far. The feast was the weapon. 💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Dmitri.
No watches tonight. Everyone sleeps with one ear open and pretends not to.
🏃 Tariq of Ashford walks into Haven unannounced, pack-mules behind. "Heard your bins are echoing. Ashford has grain to spare — 2,081 kcal, no tribute, no ceremony. Say the word."
(Aid offer — accept or refuse from the beats row. Refusing costs pride: trust -3.)
You accept Ashford's food — 2,081 kcal on the road, 2 day-parts out. Tariq clasps your runner's shoulder. "That's what the fire network is FOR." (Trust +4.)

💛 You hold Carpenter's square. Your first solo frame, checked and found true. The nod that followed was the whole ceremony. Measure twice, cut once — it's in your hands now. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are still yours. The feast was the weapon.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
🍽️ Thabo stands in the pantry doorway a moment. "Look at all this. Tending the fire today — someone ought to keep the stories."
"There's hurt to tend and bellies to fill. Triage for the hurt, rations to stretch what's left, or a hard hunt to replace what we lost."

💛 You hold Boot stone. You carry a guilt like a stone in the boot. So you carry a stone in the boot — the scattering took the one person you were keeping alive, and this is the shape of that. It keeps you honest. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they know your hands. The feast was the weapon. 🌙 Raid — Ashford came in the night from the southwest. They trampled 2 garden plots into mud. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
The first night of Winter. A day ends at the fire; a season ends there too, only longer. The village sits up late.
Behind us: Autumn. Harvest season. Nuts, persimmons, last greens. Fatten up. The Codex grew this season — 45 new: Elderberry, Common Plantain, Jerusalem Artichoke (+42 more).
